{{Nickname}}
{{Quote|You go on with your conspiracy theories. Tell you something - no matter what kind of theory you come up with, you always miss the real cause of whatever's going on. Think you know? You don't. Think you got a clue? Whatever. You couldn't buy a clue from a corrupt OPS hound with a pastry fetish.|l337b0i, responding to mstrslcr on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an individual used the handle '''l337b0i''' as a user ID when posting on the [[Cularin holonet node]].<ref name="destabilization" />

Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Operation False Horizon]], the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Tiny.f]] shared on the Cularin holonet node what was purported to be leaked communique from [[Jir Tramsig]],<ref name="destabilization" /> the leader of [[Thaereian military]] forces in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="Over Thaere">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011004b_thaere&c=swlfc|text=Over Thaere}}</ref> that referenced a [[Thaereian]] plot to cause social and economic disruption on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. This triggered widespread discussion on the [[HoloNet/Legends|holonet]] forum regarding the legitimacy of the message, including a responses by the users [[0/Legends|__0__]] and [[mstrslcr]] claiming the alleged Thaereian scheme to be legitimate. From aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] docked at [[Varna Biqua]],<ref name="destabilization" /> a floating [[City/Legends|city]] on the Cularin system [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]],<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> l337b0i posted a response on the forum that accused mstrslcr of being uninformed; l337b0i also spoofed the node location recorded for this message to 0.0.0, the same location as used in the post by __0__, to illustrate that a node location logged on a Cularin holonet node forum post could be falsified. The slicer [[alyssa]]roxu responded and publicly disclosed on the forum l337b0i's true location, on Varna Biqua.<ref name="destabilization" />

At a later time, mstrslcr posted on the Cularin holonet node an intercepted message that some users interpreted as a report by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] representative recommending intervention in the operation of the [[Almas Academy]], a [[Jedi academy]] on the planet [[Almas]]. Sceptical that the message was Jedi-related, l337b0i reviewed the intercept with a [[text analyzer]] and concluded that the [[Language/Legends|language]] and syntax used were not consistent with other Jedi [[Writing/Legends|writings]].<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref>
